野.meaning: field, plain, wild — 野菜 (vegetables), 野球 (baseball)
野.label: noun

少.reading: ショウ, すく(ない), すこ(し)
少.label: i-adjective

得.meaning: gain, profit, acquire — 得意 (good at), 得る (to obtain)
得.label: verb

意.meaning: mind, will, intention, meaning — 意味, 注意, 得意
意.label: noun

酒.reading: シュ, さけ, さか
酒.meaning: alcohol, sake, rice wine — お酒 (おさけ)
酒.label: noun

頭.reading: トウ, ズ, あたま
頭.meaning: head — also counter for large animals (cattle); 頭がいい (smart)
頭.label: noun

痛.meaning: painful, sore — 頭痛 (ずつう, headache)
痛.label: i-adjective

早.meaning: early — exception trap: same はやい reading as 速い (fast/speedy); 早い = time, 速い = speed
早.label: i-adjective

開.reading: カイ, ひら(く), あ(く), あ(ける)
開.meaning: open — transitive 開ける (あける), intransitive 開く (あく)
開.label: verb

降.reading: コウ, ふ(る), お(りる)
降.meaning: fall (precipitation), get off (a vehicle) — 雨が降る, 電車を降りる
降.label: verb

持.meaning: hold, carry, possess — 持っている (to have)
持.label: verb

魚.reading: ギョ, さかな, うお
魚.label: noun

椅.meaning: chair — almost exclusively in 椅子 (いす)
椅.label: noun

立.reading: リツ, リュウ, た(つ), た(てる)
立.meaning: stand, set up — 立つ (to stand), 立てる (to set up)
立.label: verb

試.reading: シ, こころ(みる), ため(す)
試.meaning: try, attempt, test — 試験 (exam), 試す (to try)
試.label: verb

験.meaning: test, examination, effect — 試験 (しけん), 経験 (experience)
験.label: noun

外.reading: ガイ, ゲ, そと, ほか, はず(す)
外.meaning: outside, foreign — 外国 (foreign country), 外人 (foreigner)
外.label: noun

横.meaning: side, beside, horizontal — generic 'next to', not necessarily same kind
横.label: noun

隣.meaning: next to, neighbor — implies same category (e.g. house next to house)
隣.label: noun

銀.meaning: silver — 銀行 (ぎんこう, bank)
銀.label: noun

郵.meaning: mail, post — almost only in 郵便 (mail), 郵便局 (post office)
郵.label: noun

局.meaning: bureau, office, station — 郵便局 (post office), 放送局 (broadcasting station)
局.label: noun-suffix

停.meaning: stop, halt — バス停 (bus stop), 停電 (power outage)
停.label: noun-suffix

瓶.meaning: bottle, jar — counter for bottled drinks
瓶.label: counter

様.meaning: Mr./Ms. (very polite honorific), appearance, manner — more formal than さん
様.label: honorific

彼.meaning: he, him, boyfriend — 彼女 (かのじょ, she/girlfriend)
彼.label: pronoun

医.meaning: medicine, doctor — 医者 (doctor), 医学 (medicine, the field)
医.label: noun

者.meaning: person — suffix for occupations/types: 医者, 学者, 若者
者.label: noun-suffix

太.reading: タイ, タ, ふと(い), ふと(る)
太.meaning: thick, fat, plump — also common in male names (e.g. 太郎)
太.label: i-adjective

郎.meaning: son, male suffix — used in male names like 太郎 (Tarō), 次郎 (Jirō)
郎.label: name-suffix

員.meaning: member, staff — suffix: 社員 (company employee), 店員 (shop clerk), 銀行員 (bank employee)
員.label: noun-suffix

匹.meaning: counter for small animals — sound changes: 一匹 いっぴき, 三匹 さんびき, 六匹 ろっぴき
匹.label: counter

住.meaning: live, reside — 住所 (address), 住む (to live)
住.label: verb

台.meaning: stand, platform; counter for vehicles and machines — 一台 いちだい
台.label: counter

番.meaning: number, turn, order — 一番 (best/number one), 番号 (number)
番.label: noun

引.meaning: pull, draw — 引っ越し (moving house), 引く (pull/look up)
引.label: verb

越.reading: エツ, こ(える), こ(す)
越.meaning: cross over, exceed, move (residence) — 引っ越し (ひっこし)
越.label: verb

性.meaning: nature, gender, -ness — 性格 (personality), 女性/男性 (female/male)
性.label: noun-suffix

格.meaning: status, character, rank, case — 性格 (personality), 合格 (passing an exam)
格.label: noun

写.meaning: copy, photograph, transcribe — 写真 (photo), 写す (to copy/photograph)
写.label: verb

真.meaning: true, real, genuine — 写真 (photo), 真っ赤 (deep red)
真.label: noun

撮.meaning: take (a photograph) — exception trap: same とる reading as 取る, 採る, 捕る; 撮る = photograph only
撮.label: verb

司.meaning: administer, manage, director — 寿司 (sushi), 司会 (master of ceremonies)
司.label: noun

回.reading: カイ, まわ(る), まわ(す)
回.meaning: times, occurrence (counter); rotate, turn — 一回 (one time), 回る (to spin)
回.label: counter

歳.meaning: years old (counter for age) — exceptions: 20歳 はたち (NOT にじゅっさい), often simplified as 才
歳.label: counter

動.reading: ドウ, うご(く), うご(かす)
動.meaning: move, motion — 動物 (animal), 自動車 (car), 運動 (exercise)
動.label: verb

看.meaning: watch over, look after — 看護師 (nurse), 看板 (signboard)
看.label: verb

護.meaning: protect, defend, guard — 看護 (nursing), 保護 (protection)
護.label: verb

師.meaning: teacher, master, professional — 看護師 (nurse), 教師 (teacher), 医師 (physician)
師.label: noun-suffix

得意(とくい).meaning: good at, one's specialty, proud — opposite of 苦手 (にがて, bad at)
得意(とくい).label: na-adjective

上.meaning: above, on top of, up — positional noun, used with の: 机の上
上.label: position

下.meaning: below, under, beneath — positional noun: 机の下
下.label: position

前.meaning: in front of, before — also 'ago' for time: 三年前 (3 years ago)
前.label: position

後ろ.meaning: behind, back — note okurigana ろ; different from 後 (あと/ご) meaning 'after'
後ろ.label: position

中.meaning: inside, middle, within — also read ちゅう as a suffix (e.g. 勉強中)
中.label: position

横.meaning: side, beside — generic 'next to' (different categories OK, e.g. person next to building)
横.label: position

隣.meaning: next to (adjacent neighbor) — implies same category, e.g. house next to house, person next to person. Contrast with 横
隣.label: position

間.meaning: between, interval, space — also read ま (a pause) or かん (duration, e.g. 時間)
間.label: position

近く.meaning: near, nearby, vicinity — noun form of 近い
近く.label: position

六日.meaning: 6th day of the month, six days — exception: NOT ろくにち
六日.label: date

七日.meaning: 7th day of the month, seven days — exception: NOT しちにち or ななにち
七日.label: date
